title: Position bound from unit steps
statement: Let $p:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$ satisfy $p(0)=0$ and $|p(j+1)-p(j)|\le 1$ for every natural number $j$. For any natural number $t$, every $z$ among $p(0),p(1),\ldots,p(t)$ satisfies $|z|<N$, where $N$ is the number of distinct values in that list.
hypotheses_covered: Every successive difference has absolute value at most $1$
$z$ belongs to the image of indices $0$ through $t$ under $p$
